issues.explanation: create() derives $slug but never passes it to CreateQueue, and rename() never passes the re-derived slug to UpdateQueue, so the slug-from-name contract cannot work.
Queues view renders only the list and a create-modal placeholder; required create, detail, rename, toggle-confirmation and access modals are absent.
Serve view has no waiting list, mode selector, channel translation, or serve_empty empty state; only queue buttons and call-next button are rendered.
callableQueues returns empty for employees with an explicit simplified comment instead of checking call grants.
waitingTickets ignores mode filtering and never checks whether the user may call the queue, and accessGrants returns memberships instead of grants.
callNext swallows a foreign or missing selectedQueueId into serve_empty instead of letting the scoped findOrFail raise not-found.
Rate-limit path references ui.serve_rate_limited which exists in neither lang file.
Navbar dropdown was not updated despite nav_queues and nav_serve lang keys being added.
confirmToggle assigns viewingQueueId directly from the client id without a scoped lookup, unlike openQueue and toggleActive.
waitingTickets returns tickets for any entity queue without authorizing call permission, disclosing queue contents.
lastCalledTicketId is a public writable property although the task requires it not to be client-writable.
No Queues or Serve action calls $this->authorize after mount, and mount uses authorize('create', Queue::class, $entity) with a dangling third argument.
renameName and mode/selectedQueueId have no #[Validate] rules, and validateOnly('renameName') therefore validates nothing.
Internal helpers callableQueues and waitingTickets are public endpoints instead of protected or computed properties.
Unused imports, dead $slug variable, blank trailing-argument call fragments, and missing EOF newline leave scaffolding noise.
Interactive queue and serve buttons lack the required aria-labels.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:55 has #[Validate] only on name; renameName at :63, Serve mode at Serve.php:237 have none; callableQueues/waitingTickets at Serve.php:249,271 are public; unused imports Log/RateLimiter/User; no docs update

readability.evidence: resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:449 list matches sibling member rows; but Queues.php:100-102 and :143-145 have blank trailing-arg fragments, dead $slug, and serve.blade.php ends without newline

requirements.evidence: queues.blade.php:449-462 list only plus placeholder, no detail/rename/toggle/access modals; Queues.php:100-102 slug unused; Serve.php:259-260 grants unimplemented; serve.blade.php:474-489 no waiting list or mode filter; navbar untouched

scope.evidence: diff touches only Members.php, Queues.php, Serve.php, two lang files, three blades and routes/web.php; extra queues_inactive/serve_title keys are trivial

security.evidence: mount auth at Queues.php:67 and Serve.php:243 present and most lookups use entity->queues()->findOrFail; but confirmToggle at Queues.php:153-157 trusts $id, waitingTickets at Serve.php:271-287 has no call check, lastCalledTicketId at Serve.php:238 is writable

simplicity.evidence: reuses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket; but Queues.php:36-43 unused imports, Queues.php:98 dead $slug, queues.blade.php:461 placeholder comment

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ directory or *Test.php additions for queues, serve, tabs, unauthorized-call or tamper cases

review.summary: Adds routes, lang keys, queue list, serve shell and member tabs, but leaves Queues and Serve half-built with broken slug passing, missing modals and waiting list, unimplemented employee grants, and no tests. Security gaps around unscoped confirmToggle, unauthenticated ticket reads and writable lastCalledTicketId need substantial rework before merge.
